payout_quote: California pays jurors $15 every day starting on the second day of service; jurors receive at least 34 cents per mile round-trip (from day two) or up to $12/day for public transit (from day one). Government employees receiving full pay are excluded.
steps: Receive a California state court jury summons
Receive $15/day from day two plus mileage/transit reimbursement
catches: No pay for day one — and California's one-day/one-trial system means most jurors serve only one day ($0).
Government employees get no fee (already paid by employer).
Mileage starts day two; only transit reimbursement starts day one.
biggest_catch: Most Californians serve a single day and earn $0 — the $15/day starts on day two.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in California state courts (non-government employees).
timing: Computed at completion; mailed within weeks.
